import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Create model
model = gp.Model("bakery_fiber_minimization")

# Decision variables
# b = number of brownies
# l = number of lemon squares
b = model.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="brownies", lb=0)
l = model.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="lemon_squares", lb=0)

# Objective: minimize total fiber used
model.setObjective(4 * b + 6 * l, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Resource constraints
model.addConstr(5 * b <= 2500, name="chocolate_mix")
model.addConstr(7 * l <= 3300, name="lemon_mix")

# Lemon squares must be more than brownies
model.addConstr(l >= b + 1, name="more_lemon_than_brownies")

# At least 40% of items must be brownies
# b / (b + l) >= 0.4  ->  3b - 2l >= 0
model.addConstr(3 * b - 2 * l >= 0, name="brownie_fraction")

model.optimize()
print(model.objVal)
```
